title: Georgia renter warned landlord about tree; after it crushed his home, appeals court revived claims
summary_full: William Frank Jennings, a Lindale, Georgia resident, became paralyzed after a tree fell on his house, despite having warned his landlord about its dangerous state. The Georgia Court of Appeals ruled that his claims against Romulus Investments were improperly dismissed, noting significant conflicting evidence regarding hazard notifications. This ruling enables Jennings to pursue his case further to potentially establish liability and seek damages for his injuries.
